propositions: Agent configured with Serena LSP still invokes grep manually for symbol enumeration instead of using find_referencing_symbols, caused by launch-time guidance losing salience mid-task
A PreToolUse hook on Bash must emit a non-blocking reminder when grep-family commands (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) are invoked, using only dumb string matching with no pattern or path classification

The reminder message must be 2-3 lines, name both the preferred Serena tool and the legitimate grep use cases (string literals, line numbers), and be emitted as JSON with additionalContext but no permissionDecision
The hook must never block execution, exit non-zero, or emit permissionDecision even on malformed input, and must preserve existing settings like env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH in .claude/settings.json
